exposure: type of cervical ripening method used
cohort: 63 pregnant women with a history of one previous lower segment caesarean section and an unsalvageable infant, willing to attempt vaginal birth after caesarean section
finding: Cervical ripening balloons were associated with a greater increase in Bishop score and a higher rate of vaginal delivery compared to Foley's catheter induction.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was higher in the cervical ripening balloon group compared to the Foley's group.
